Two Rails constructions have no TS counterpart in this body: `InstanceMethodsOnActivation.new(attribute, reset_token:)` (secure_password.rb:127) is `include`d as a dynamically-built module — TS cannot include an instance, so the accessors are installed with `defineProperty` — and `BCrypt::Password.new(digest_was).is_password?(challenge)` (secure_password.rb:144) is one-shot `bcrypt.compareSync(challenge, digestWas)` in node, which exposes no Password object. Language shortcomings.
